texts: Moderate or severe acute cellular rejection (grade 2R or 3R) is marked by multiple foci of myocyte injury: A.
In the picture, the soldier ants swarm in two or more places, and at each the bricks of the engine-room wall are broken.
Mild rejection (1R) shows infiltrates with at most one focus of myocyte damage; severe rejection is diffuse, often with oedema or haemorrhage.
Positive C4d staining and macrophages inside capillaries are signs of antibody-mediated rejection, not of cellular rejection.
Memory hook: ants biting bricks in more than one place mean moderate rejection or worse.
